tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Similar nature/ Similar Category of Single work done of Manpower service Provided at least min 100% in any one single year of last 5 financial years to any ULBs State / Central Govt. offices or any Institutions same to be enclosed

The Agency should have experience in providing 32 Employees Manpower Services of Skilled and Unskilled Manpower to any one office of state Government Offices and Government Boards & Corporations. Experience certificate to uploaded
Registration certificate from Labour Department under Contract Labour Act of competent Government authority.
Copy of firm prevailing trade license taken by BBMP /TMC /CMC /GP /CITY CORPORATION/HDMC and other concerned authorities

Must have Registration Certificate under Employees State Insurance Act (ESI ACT). And remitted at least Rs. 50.00 Lakhs to ESI accounts in last 3 years 2022-23. 2023-24. 2024-25. (year wise ESI returns details from the authority to be enclosed)

Must have Employee Provident Fund Registration Certificate issued by the Regional Provident Fund Commissioner. And remitted at least Rs. 1.00 Crores to EPF accounts in last 3 years 2022-23. 2023-24. 2024-25. (year wise EPF returns details from the authority to be enclosed)
Company should be ISO-9001 Certified for Manpower supply, certificate to be enclosed
